push.title: L 3-4 vs FAFO CF | You: 8.2
push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.2. You were reliable as a porch light, and that matters more than you know.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at FAFO CF's goal. You kept the keeper busier than a one-man band.
+ 11th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's the bit I'll replay in my head on the drive home.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after buddskees walked off. I see you, and I like what I see.
+ 30 of the team's 60 on-ball actions: the team ran through you. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.
+ 1 key pass: +0.1. Little things, big difference.

THE BAD
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 2. Fundamentals: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
- A promotion match, and we lost it. Nobody carries that alone. We carry it as a team.
- Pass accuracy: 76%. Good foundation, 88%+ ceiling.
- Goals per shot on target: 40%. 60%+ is the gold standard for a forward.
- Key passes: 1. Climb to 2+ and you're top quarter.

Training note: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.

PhogsToffees, here's what I'd tell my own kid: The ball will find the player who wants it. Want it.

Practice makes progress. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 3-4 vs FAFO CF | You: 7.9
push.body:
A 7.9, BellyTb1. That's a B-plus kind of day, and I happen to love B-plus days.

THE GOOD
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). That's what I call neighborly football.
+ You saw PhogsToffees's run before PhogsToffees did.
+ Stayed on and finished the match after buddskees walked off. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.
+ 3rd straight match at 7.5 match rating. That doesn't happen by accident.
+ 27 of the team's 52 passes attempted: the team ran through you. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Small change, big gain: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot. Small fix, big smile.
- Tackles attempted 1, down from your usual 3. Numbers don't lie, even when we wish they would.
- A promotion match, and we lost it. That's on all of us, not just you, and all of us fix it.
- Pass accuracy: 78%. That's a B. The A-students among forwards are at 88%+.
- A one-goal loss (3-4): a single moment decided it. That stings the whole locker room, and it should.

Teach your feet: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound.

BellyTb1, write this on your hand if you have to: Doubt is a guest. Don't give it the spare room.

I believe in you. More importantly, I need you to believe in you. - Coach Lasso

One thought for the road, buddskees: Don't be afraid of the dark. That's when the stars come out.

You're closer than you think. - Coach Lasso
